verse: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
story: Judah's kings have scattered the flock they were meant to feed, so God promises to send a shepherd of His own.

The LORD says days are coming when He will raise up for David a righteous Branch. This King will reign wisely and do justice and righteousness in the land. Jeremiah goes on to name Him The LORD Our Righteousness. Against the comfortable lies of the false prophets, God's word stands firm and fiery: the right King is coming, and He will not fail His people as the others did.
Take heart that the world's disorder is not the last word. A righteous King is on His way.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
